Account.Disabled.title: An account was disabled: it cannot sign in and its sessions and agent tokens stop working.

Account.Enabled.title: A disabled account was enabled again.

Account.PasswordChanged.title: The password of an account was set or changed.

Account.RolesSet.title: The roles of an account were replaced.

Action.Failed.title: The action failed for good (not retried any more).

Action.Requested.title: An action was requested on records.

ActionDefinition.Retired.title: An action was retired: it can no longer be invoked; its invocations stay readable.

ActionDefinition.Revised.title: An action was revised; the event carries the whole new definition and the row is replaced.

ActionDefinition.SecretRotated.title: A new signing secret was issued for a webhook action; the previous one keeps verifying until the overlap ends.

ActivityRef.Defined.title: The first link to an activity made its reference.

ActivityRef.PresenceChanged.title: A publication found the activity gone from the schedule (present false) or back (present true).

AgentToken.Revoked.title: An agent token was revoked and no longer authenticates.

CodeValue.Closed.title: A code value was superseded by another or retired; it still resolves for old records.

CodeValue.Defined.title: A value was added to a code list.

Commercial.Assessed.title: The other party assessed an issued Commercial item: agreed, disputed or partially agreed, with the value they assessed.

Commercial.Defined.title: A Commercial item (early warning, change notice, claim ...) was raised.

Commercial.Updated.title: The domain fields of a Commercial item that is not yet issued changed.

ContractClause.Retired.title: A clause was retired; clocks that cited it keep their reference.

Correspondence.ClearanceGranted.title: An account was named as able to read a privileged item (ADR-0016).

Correspondence.ClearanceWithdrawn.title: An account was removed from the readers of a privileged item.

Correspondence.ConfidentialityChanged.title: The confidentiality class of an item changed (a controller's act, ADR-0016).

Correspondence.Defined.title: A correspondence item was received, drafted or logged.

Correspondence.Issued.title: An outgoing item was issued: its text was rendered to a PDF (stored in the slot `rendition`) and sent.

Correspondence.Reclassified.title: The domain or subtype of an item changed before it was issued.

Correspondence.Responded.title: An answer to an item was issued or received.

Correspondence.Superseded.title: An item was replaced by another item; it stays in the ledger.

Correspondence.ThreadAssigned.title: An item joined a thread, and optionally answers another item.

Correspondence.Triaged.title: A person confirmed the domain and subtype of a received item, with the records it refers to and the clocks that were started.

Correspondence.Updated.title: The register fields of a draft or received item changed (the subject changes through the core `Record.Updated`).

CorrespondenceThread.Defined.title: A thread was opened by its first item.

CorrespondenceThread.StateChanged.title: A thread was closed or reopened.

CostCode.Defined.title: A cost code was registered (by the first snapshot that names it).

CostCode.MeasuresRecorded.title: A snapshot stated the figures of a cost code.

CostCode.Revised.title: A snapshot changed the description, parent or unit of measure of an existing cost code.

CostSnapshot.Defined.title: A period of figures was imported.

DerivedDocument.ContentRecorded.title: One extractor pass over a source file finished: a new content revision of the derived document.

DerivedDocument.Defined.title: A derived document was opened for a source revision and a document schema.

DerivedDocument.PublicationCompensated.title: The publication of a derived document was rolled back: reversing events for everything its import made were appended under a correlation id of their own.

DerivedDocument.Published.title: The rows of a valid content revision were published into target records as one correlated import.

DerivedDocument.Validated.title: A content revision was checked against a document schema version.

Document.CurrentRevisionChanged.title: The revision in force for a document changed (an issue, a supersession or a void).

Document.Defined.title: A document was registered under its number.

Document.Superseded.title: A document was replaced by another document; it stays in the ledger and its links go stale.

Document.Updated.title: The register fields of a document changed (the title changes through the core `Record.Updated`).

DocumentSchema.Defined.title: A version of a document schema was registered.

DocumentSchema.Retired.title: A version of a document schema was retired; documents that named it keep it.

Enricher.Revised.title: An enricher's registration changed; the event carries the whole new registration.

Enrichment.Accepted.title: A person (or the enricher's own auto policy) accepted a value: it is now written to the enricher's layer of the record.

Enrichment.Proposed.title: An enricher proposed a value for a property of its own layer of a record.

Enrichment.Rejected.title: A value was rejected by a person, or replaced by a newer proposal.

Feed.Posted.title: A post was made in a project feed.

Feed.Reacted.title: A reaction was set or cleared on a post.

File.Processed.title: A file passed its scan and is available.

File.Rejected.title: A file failed its scan and was rejected.

File.Uploaded.title: A file was uploaded and attached to a record; it is quarantined until its scan finishes.

Inbound.Applied.title: A delivery was mapped and its commands ran (or, for a dry-run endpoint, were planned).

Inbound.Failed.title: A delivery could not be applied; it is in the error queue until an admin retries it.

Inbound.Received.title: A signed POST was accepted and queued for mapping.

Inbound.Retried.title: An admin re-ran a failed delivery, optionally with a corrected payload.

InboundEndpoint.Disabled.title: An endpoint stopped accepting deliveries; it answers 404.

InboundEndpoint.Revised.title: An endpoint was revised; the event carries the whole new definition (no secret).

InboundEndpoint.SecretRotated.title: A new secret was issued; the previous one keeps verifying until the overlap ends (at most 24 hours).

IntegrationApp.Disabled.title: An app was switched off: its endpoints answer 404 and its rules, actions and enrichers do nothing.

IntegrationApp.Enabled.title: An app was switched on: its endpoints, rules, actions and enrichers run again.

IntegrationApp.Revised.title: An app's label, description or owner changed.

Link.Accepted.title: A suggested link was accepted and is now active.

Link.Added.title: A link between two records became active.

Link.Declined.title: A suggested link was declined; it will not be suggested again.

Link.Flagged.title: A link was flagged stale or broken.

Link.Repinned.title: The pin of a link was set to another revision.

Link.Suggested.title: A link was suggested and waits for a person to accept or decline.

Link.Verified.title: A person verified an active link.

Numbering.Allocated.title: A number was allocated from a counter.

Party.ContactAdded.title: A contact was added to a party.

Party.Defined.title: A party was entered, with its first contacts.

ProcessingJob.Cancelled.title: A queued job was cancelled before a worker took it.

ProcessingJob.Started.title: A worker claimed a job (attempt n).

ProcessingJob.Succeeded.title: The claimed attempt finished and its results were recorded.

Proposal.Accepted.title: A person accepted a proposal and its command ran in the same transaction.

Proposal.Failed.title: A person accepted a proposal, but the command was refused (the record changed since, a guard failed).

Pset.ValuesSet.title: Values of a property set were written on a record.

Record.BodyStored.title: The body of an object-backed record was stored as a content-addressed object.

Record.Corrected.title: A recorded value was corrected after the fact; history keeps the original.

Record.Updated.title: One or more fields of a record changed.

Rendition.Defined.title: A file was registered as a rendition of a revision.

Rendition.Superseded.title: A rendition was replaced by a newer one of the same kind on the same revision.

ResponseClock.Cancelled.title: The clock was cancelled: no answer is needed any more.

ResponseClock.Expired.title: The sweep found a running clock past its due date.

ResponseClock.Met.title: The clock was met: the answer came in time (or late; the date says which).

ResponseClock.Paused.title: A clock was paused; the days of the pause do not count.

ResponseClock.Restarted.title: A clock started its count again from a new day zero, with the same parameters.

ResponseClock.Resumed.title: A paused clock ran again; the due date moved by the days of the pause.

ResponseClock.Warned.title: The sweep found a running clock at or inside a warning threshold smaller than the last one raised.

ReviewCycle.Closed.title: A review cycle was closed with an overall outcome.

ReviewCycle.Defined.title: A review of a revision was opened with its reviewers.

Revision.Defined.title: A revision of a document was created, as a draft.

Revision.Issued.title: A revision was issued with an issue status; it is now current for its status class.

Revision.Superseded.title: An issued revision stopped being current because a later one replaced it.

Rule.Blocked.title: A matched event did not run the rule: the step was refused, the causation depth limit or a budget stopped it.

Rule.Enabled.title: A rule was switched on, from this event on.

Rule.Revised.title: A rule was revised; the event carries the whole new rule.

Schedule.OrphansChecked.title: One run of the job that makes the links to a schedule's activities agree with its current snapshot (ADR-0015 section 5): activity references whose presence changed, links flagged stale (their activity is gone) and links restored (it came back).

Schedule.SnapshotPublished.title: A snapshot became the schedule's current one.

ScheduleSnapshot.BuildFailed.title: A build attempt failed (a limit breach, a crash, a lease that ran out).

ScheduleSnapshot.Built.title: The file was read and passed the XER document schema; the typed rows were written.

ScheduleSnapshot.Defined.title: A snapshot was opened for a schedule; the XER file is attached next.

ScheduleSnapshot.MadeCurrent.title: A snapshot was made the schedule's current one.

ScheduleSnapshot.Queued.title: The build of a snapshot was queued: the XER file is fixed.

ScheduleSnapshot.Rejected.title: The file was read and is not a valid schedule snapshot (or could not be read): the snapshot is Invalid and no rows were written.

Schema.EffectiveChanged.title: The effective schema of a scope changed.

SchemaPackage.Published.title: A schema package version was published.

Setting.Changed.title: One key was set, or reset to what the layer above gives, at one layer.

Setting.Locked.title: The company locked a key for its projects, unlocked it, or changed the bounds projects must keep to.

Standard.Closed.title: A registry entry was superseded by another or retired; it stays resolvable for history.

Standard.Defined.title: A registry entry (a code list, a mnemonic or a numbering pattern) was defined.

Tag.Defined.title: A tag was created, with its number parsed into segments and its class.

Tag.Reclassified.title: A tag moved to another class; the new class may bind other property sets.

Tag.Superseded.title: A tag was replaced by one or more others (a rename, a split or a merge); it stays in the ledger as history.

TagClass.Closed.title: A tag class was retired; tags already of that class keep it.

Technical.Answered.title: The answer to a Technical item was recorded, with the answerer's statement on cost and schedule.

Technical.Defined.title: A Technical item (RFI, technical query or deviation request) was raised.

Technical.Reissued.title: A rejected Technical item went back to internal review to be issued again.

Technical.Reviewed.title: The raiser accepted or rejected the answer.

Technical.Updated.title: The domain fields of a Technical item that is a draft or in internal review changed.

Thread.Dispatched.title: A slash command in a thread was confirmed and its commands ran, in the same transaction as the message of kind `dispatch` that carries the command line.

Thread.MessageEdited.title: The author replaced the body of a message.

Thread.MessagePosted.title: A message was posted in a record thread.

Transmittal.Defined.title: A transmittal was drafted with the revisions it carries and its recipients.

Transmittal.Issued.title: A transmittal was issued to its recipients.

TypeRegistration.Quarantined.title: A type package failed validation, or its files changed under a version that is already registered.

TypeRegistration.Registered.title: A type package validated and was registered.

WebhookSubscription.Enabled.title: A disabled subscription started receiving events again, from this event on.

WebhookSubscription.SecretRotated.title: A new signing secret was issued; the previous one keeps signing until the overlap ends.

WebhookSubscription.Updated.title: A subscription's name, target, filter or payload mode changed.

Workflow.Transitioned.title: A record moved from one workflow state to another.

receiveAccountDisabled.summary: An account was disabled: it cannot sign in and its sessions and agent tokens stop working.

receiveAccountEnabled.summary: A disabled account was enabled again.

receiveAccountPasswordChanged.summary: The password of an account was set or changed.

receiveAccountRolesSet.summary: The roles of an account were replaced.

receiveActionDefinitionRetired.summary: An action was retired: it can no longer be invoked; its invocations stay readable.

receiveActionDefinitionRevised.summary: An action was revised; the event carries the whole new definition and the row is replaced.

receiveActionDefinitionSecretRotated.summary: A new signing secret was issued for a webhook action; the previous one keeps verifying until the overlap ends.

receiveActionFailed.summary: The action failed for good (not retried any more).

receiveActionRequested.summary: An action was requested on records.

receiveActivityRefDefined.summary: The first link to an activity made its reference.

receiveActivityRefPresenceChanged.summary: A publication found the activity gone from the schedule (present false) or back (present true).

receiveAgentTokenRevoked.summary: An agent token was revoked and no longer authenticates.

receiveCodeValueClosed.summary: A code value was superseded by another or retired; it still resolves for old records.

receiveCodeValueDefined.summary: A value was added to a code list.

receiveCommercialAssessed.summary: The other party assessed an issued Commercial item: agreed, disputed or partially agreed, with the value they assessed.

receiveCommercialDefined.summary: A Commercial item (early warning, change notice, claim ...) was raised.

receiveCommercialUpdated.summary: The domain fields of a Commercial item that is not yet issued changed.

receiveContractClauseRetired.summary: A clause was retired; clocks that cited it keep their reference.

receiveCorrespondenceClearanceGranted.summary: An account was named as able to read a privileged item (ADR-0016).

receiveCorrespondenceClearanceWithdrawn.summary: An account was removed from the readers of a privileged item.

receiveCorrespondenceConfidentialityChan.summary: The confidentiality class of an item changed (a controller's act, ADR-0016).

receiveCorrespondenceDefined.summary: A correspondence item was received, drafted or logged.

receiveCorrespondenceIssued.summary: An outgoing item was issued: its text was rendered to a PDF (stored in the slot `rendition`) and sent.

receiveCorrespondenceReclassified.summary: The domain or subtype of an item changed before it was issued.

receiveCorrespondenceResponded.summary: An answer to an item was issued or received.

receiveCorrespondenceSuperseded.summary: An item was replaced by another item; it stays in the ledger.

receiveCorrespondenceThreadAssigned.summary: An item joined a thread, and optionally answers another item.

receiveCorrespondenceThreadDefined.summary: A thread was opened by its first item.

receiveCorrespondenceThreadStateChanged.summary: A thread was closed or reopened.

receiveCorrespondenceTriaged.summary: A person confirmed the domain and subtype of a received item, with the records it refers to and the clocks that were started.

receiveCorrespondenceUpdated.summary: The register fields of a draft or received item changed (the subject changes through the core `Record.Updated`).

receiveCostCodeDefined.summary: A cost code was registered (by the first snapshot that names it).

receiveCostCodeMeasuresRecorded.summary: A snapshot stated the figures of a cost code.

receiveCostCodeRevised.summary: A snapshot changed the description, parent or unit of measure of an existing cost code.

receiveCostSnapshotDefined.summary: A period of figures was imported.

receiveDerivedDocumentContentRecorded.summary: One extractor pass over a source file finished: a new content revision of the derived document.

receiveDerivedDocumentDefined.summary: A derived document was opened for a source revision and a document schema.

receiveDerivedDocumentPublicationCompens.summary: The publication of a derived document was rolled back: reversing events for everything its import made were appended under a correlation id of their own.

receiveDerivedDocumentPublished.summary: The rows of a valid content revision were published into target records as one correlated import.

receiveDerivedDocumentValidated.summary: A content revision was checked against a document schema version.

receiveDocumentCurrentRevisionChanged.summary: The revision in force for a document changed (an issue, a supersession or a void).

receiveDocumentDefined.summary: A document was registered under its number.

receiveDocumentSchemaDefined.summary: A version of a document schema was registered.

receiveDocumentSchemaRetired.summary: A version of a document schema was retired; documents that named it keep it.

receiveDocumentSuperseded.summary: A document was replaced by another document; it stays in the ledger and its links go stale.

receiveDocumentUpdated.summary: The register fields of a document changed (the title changes through the core `Record.Updated`).

receiveEnricherRevised.summary: An enricher's registration changed; the event carries the whole new registration.

receiveEnrichmentAccepted.summary: A person (or the enricher's own auto policy) accepted a value: it is now written to the enricher's layer of the record.

receiveEnrichmentProposed.summary: An enricher proposed a value for a property of its own layer of a record.

receiveEnrichmentRejected.summary: A value was rejected by a person, or replaced by a newer proposal.

receiveFeedPosted.summary: A post was made in a project feed.

receiveFeedReacted.summary: A reaction was set or cleared on a post.

receiveFileProcessed.summary: A file passed its scan and is available.

receiveFileRejected.summary: A file failed its scan and was rejected.

receiveFileUploaded.summary: A file was uploaded and attached to a record; it is quarantined until its scan finishes.

receiveInboundApplied.summary: A delivery was mapped and its commands ran (or, for a dry-run endpoint, were planned).

receiveInboundEndpointDisabled.summary: An endpoint stopped accepting deliveries; it answers 404.

receiveInboundEndpointRevised.summary: An endpoint was revised; the event carries the whole new definition (no secret).

receiveInboundEndpointSecretRotated.summary: A new secret was issued; the previous one keeps verifying until the overlap ends (at most 24 hours).

receiveInboundFailed.summary: A delivery could not be applied; it is in the error queue until an admin retries it.

receiveInboundReceived.summary: A signed POST was accepted and queued for mapping.

receiveInboundRetried.summary: An admin re-ran a failed delivery, optionally with a corrected payload.

receiveIntegrationAppDisabled.summary: An app was switched off: its endpoints answer 404 and its rules, actions and enrichers do nothing.

receiveIntegrationAppEnabled.summary: An app was switched on: its endpoints, rules, actions and enrichers run again.

receiveIntegrationAppRevised.summary: An app's label, description or owner changed.

receiveLinkAccepted.summary: A suggested link was accepted and is now active.

receiveLinkAdded.summary: A link between two records became active.

receiveLinkDeclined.summary: A suggested link was declined; it will not be suggested again.

receiveLinkFlagged.summary: A link was flagged stale or broken.

receiveLinkRepinned.summary: The pin of a link was set to another revision.

receiveLinkSuggested.summary: A link was suggested and waits for a person to accept or decline.

receiveLinkVerified.summary: A person verified an active link.

receiveNumberingAllocated.summary: A number was allocated from a counter.

receivePartyContactAdded.summary: A contact was added to a party.

receivePartyDefined.summary: A party was entered, with its first contacts.

receiveProcessingJobCancelled.summary: A queued job was cancelled before a worker took it.

receiveProcessingJobStarted.summary: A worker claimed a job (attempt n).

receiveProcessingJobSucceeded.summary: The claimed attempt finished and its results were recorded.

receiveProposalAccepted.summary: A person accepted a proposal and its command ran in the same transaction.

receiveProposalFailed.summary: A person accepted a proposal, but the command was refused (the record changed since, a guard failed).

receivePsetValuesSet.summary: Values of a property set were written on a record.

receiveRecordBodyStored.summary: The body of an object-backed record was stored as a content-addressed object.

receiveRecordCorrected.summary: A recorded value was corrected after the fact; history keeps the original.

receiveRecordUpdated.summary: One or more fields of a record changed.

receiveRenditionDefined.summary: A file was registered as a rendition of a revision.

receiveRenditionSuperseded.summary: A rendition was replaced by a newer one of the same kind on the same revision.

receiveResponseClockCancelled.summary: The clock was cancelled: no answer is needed any more.

receiveResponseClockExpired.summary: The sweep found a running clock past its due date.

receiveResponseClockMet.summary: The clock was met: the answer came in time (or late; the date says which).

receiveResponseClockPaused.summary: A clock was paused; the days of the pause do not count.

receiveResponseClockRestarted.summary: A clock started its count again from a new day zero, with the same parameters.

receiveResponseClockResumed.summary: A paused clock ran again; the due date moved by the days of the pause.

receiveResponseClockWarned.summary: The sweep found a running clock at or inside a warning threshold smaller than the last one raised.

receiveReviewCycleClosed.summary: A review cycle was closed with an overall outcome.

receiveReviewCycleDefined.summary: A review of a revision was opened with its reviewers.

receiveRevisionDefined.summary: A revision of a document was created, as a draft.

receiveRevisionIssued.summary: A revision was issued with an issue status; it is now current for its status class.

receiveRevisionSuperseded.summary: An issued revision stopped being current because a later one replaced it.

receiveRuleBlocked.summary: A matched event did not run the rule: the step was refused, the causation depth limit or a budget stopped it.

receiveRuleEnabled.summary: A rule was switched on, from this event on.

receiveRuleRevised.summary: A rule was revised; the event carries the whole new rule.

receiveScheduleOrphansChecked.summary: One run of the job that makes the links to a schedule's activities agree with its current snapshot (ADR-0015 section 5): activity references whose presence changed, links flagged stale (their activity is gone) and links restored (it came back).

receiveScheduleSnapshotBuildFailed.summary: A build attempt failed (a limit breach, a crash, a lease that ran out).

receiveScheduleSnapshotBuilt.summary: The file was read and passed the XER document schema; the typed rows were written.

receiveScheduleSnapshotDefined.summary: A snapshot was opened for a schedule; the XER file is attached next.

receiveScheduleSnapshotMadeCurrent.summary: A snapshot was made the schedule's current one.

receiveScheduleSnapshotPublished.summary: A snapshot became the schedule's current one.

receiveScheduleSnapshotQueued.summary: The build of a snapshot was queued: the XER file is fixed.

receiveScheduleSnapshotRejected.summary: The file was read and is not a valid schedule snapshot (or could not be read): the snapshot is Invalid and no rows were written.

receiveSchemaEffectiveChanged.summary: The effective schema of a scope changed.

receiveSchemaPackagePublished.summary: A schema package version was published.

receiveSettingChanged.summary: One key was set, or reset to what the layer above gives, at one layer.

receiveSettingLocked.summary: The company locked a key for its projects, unlocked it, or changed the bounds projects must keep to.

receiveStandardClosed.summary: A registry entry was superseded by another or retired; it stays resolvable for history.

receiveStandardDefined.summary: A registry entry (a code list, a mnemonic or a numbering pattern) was defined.

receiveTagClassClosed.summary: A tag class was retired; tags already of that class keep it.

receiveTagDefined.summary: A tag was created, with its number parsed into segments and its class.

receiveTagReclassified.summary: A tag moved to another class; the new class may bind other property sets.

receiveTagSuperseded.summary: A tag was replaced by one or more others (a rename, a split or a merge); it stays in the ledger as history.

receiveTechnicalAnswered.summary: The answer to a Technical item was recorded, with the answerer's statement on cost and schedule.

receiveTechnicalDefined.summary: A Technical item (RFI, technical query or deviation request) was raised.

receiveTechnicalReissued.summary: A rejected Technical item went back to internal review to be issued again.

receiveTechnicalReviewed.summary: The raiser accepted or rejected the answer.

receiveTechnicalUpdated.summary: The domain fields of a Technical item that is a draft or in internal review changed.

receiveThreadDispatched.summary: A slash command in a thread was confirmed and its commands ran, in the same transaction as the message of kind `dispatch` that carries the command line.

receiveThreadMessageEdited.summary: The author replaced the body of a message.

receiveThreadMessagePosted.summary: A message was posted in a record thread.

receiveTransmittalDefined.summary: A transmittal was drafted with the revisions it carries and its recipients.

receiveTransmittalIssued.summary: A transmittal was issued to its recipients.

receiveTypeRegistrationQuarantined.summary: A type package failed validation, or its files changed under a version that is already registered.

receiveTypeRegistrationRegistered.summary: A type package validated and was registered.

receiveWebhookSubscriptionEnabled.summary: A disabled subscription started receiving events again, from this event on.

receiveWebhookSubscriptionSecretRotated.summary: A new signing secret was issued; the previous one keeps signing until the overlap ends.

receiveWebhookSubscriptionUpdated.summary: A subscription's name, target, filter or payload mode changed.

receiveWorkflowTransitioned.summary: A record moved from one workflow state to another.
